selection_rule: largest prospectively tested step duration passing all three wet cases
finding: The wet prescribed-qbot reference failures in F-AHL21/A are timestep-envelope failures, not evidence against the adaptive representation. At 0.0625 day all three wet reference and adaptive solves preserve the frozen fidelity and nonlinear-path gates.
next_action: Run the full 12-case prescribed-qbot matrix at factor 0.99 and dt=0.0625 day, including the previously path-sensitive O05-dry case.
nonclaims: This does not establish that 0.0625 day is a universal timestep requirement for prescribed-qbot SWAP.
No surface-regime or MODFLOW claim is made.
